notes.title: Update V.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello all! The update is done. It took a while because I work alone on this project now.

-Carrying items between levels
-Checkpoint save system
-Better updated diary for tasks
-Brighter House
-New jumpscares
-Jumpscares Triggers Improved
-Additional video settings
-Better designed Menu UI
-Atmospheric musics
-Invert Mouse x, y axis
-Running speed increased by %20
-New effect
-Some 3D Sounds quality improved
-New Cutscenes Added
-Some task order changed which are found bad by community

notes.title: Release Announcement
notes.notes: Incoming Evil is released! Enjoy the game.
